reasonToGo: The only hillside in the land where the fuel and the food come out of the same ground.

hazards.name: Seam damp
hazards.description: Air that has sat in a worked adit overnight. It puts a man on the floor before he knows he is short of breath.

hazards.name: The ember pits
hazards.description: Waste poured off from the forges and left to cool on open ground. It holds its heat for days.

resources.name: Burning stone
resources.description: Seam coal cut by hand out of the adits and carried down the ledges in baskets.

resources.name: Ledge loam
resources.description: Terrace soil, warm from the seam beneath it and shallow enough to turn with a hand fork.

landmarks.name: The terraced ledges
landmarks.description: Six or seven cut steps of field and roof stacked above the town, a stair of slate seen from the road.

landmarks.name: The adits
landmarks.description: Square black mouths opening straight into the hillside between one ledge and the next.
